start_here: Say to your AI: "Delete TidyCal booking type <id>." It runs tool:delete-a-tidycal-booking-type.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it changes one booking type on your TidyCal account.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what the test type is for.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer and check the type's id before removing it.

worked_examples.title: tool:delete-a-tidycal-booking-type
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: a DELETE to https://tidycal.com/api/booking-types/{booking_type_id} with the vault key tidycal-api-token.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the removed booking type, for example type 9999999 removed. Real values come from the live TidyCal answer.
